notes: Existing expected SHA values are preserved even when they do not match release bytes; release_sha256 is observational, not a replacement pin.
JSON SHA fields include lineage/record-only values as well as enforced checks; source consumers decide enforcement.
Source files, configs, upstream patches and license copies remain at their existing versioned paths; no duplicate source tree is bundled.
The anchor copy must be restored to runtime_path before existing entry points use it; the new folder is not an automatic path fallback.
Weights, data, caches, derived training indices, machine registrations and experiment checkpoints remain external; this is not a complete remote-training bundle.
GPU execution, actual R2 checkpoint restore and CARLA acceptance remain UNVERIFIED.
Four frozen source inputs are now bundled; overlay and original pair index use lossless gzip. Original payload bytes, source paths and all old expected SHA pins remain unchanged.

overlay/pair_index use deterministic gzip in ordinary Git; bytes/sha256 describe the original payload, stored_bytes/stored_sha256 describe the archive; restore before runtime use. No Git LFS dependency.

selection_source_manifest.note: Only these four original generator inputs are added. The derived 114,024,448-byte route-split paired_index.sqlite and 185,252,441-byte sample index remain separate external resources.
